verdict.rationale: The pack only hints at private networking. `fly doctor` checks WireGuard (fly-io-docs-22), and Fly advertises easy multi-server Elixir clustering (fly-io-docs-25), which implies some internal connectivity between machines without VPC setup. Nothing explicitly describes a private service-to-service network kept off the public internet. missing for 10: explicit docs on a built-in private network or internal DNS between apps, confirmation that internal traffic avoids the public internet, docs on keeping services private (no public IPs), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
